preview.text: South Africa Champions won the toss and chose to bowl first against England Champions in their T20 match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium. The usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches at Sharjah Cricket Stadium is 153. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 32 degrees.

summary.text: England Champions won by 46 runs. ENGCH made 189-8, Moeen Ali top-scoring with 70 off 41 balls; Robbie Frylinck took 3 for 25. SACH made 143-10, Morne van Wyk (wk) top-scoring with 31 off 25 balls; Tymal Mills took 3 for 17. Sides batting first at Sharjah Cricket Stadium usually make about 153.
